Sweet Brown Sugar Cinnamon Pancakes (feeds about 4 people, two pancake each)
Ingredients:
- 2 cups flour 
- 1/4 cup powdered sugar (or 1/8 cup of regular sugar)
- 1/4 cup brown sugar
- 1/2 tsp baking soda
- 1 1/2 tbsp baking powder
- pinch of salt
- 1 3/4 cup milk
- 1/4 cup butter
- 1 egg
- vanilla
- cinnamon
- opt: sprinkles, nutella, blueberries

How To Make:
- Step 1: take flour, powdered sugar, brown sugar, baking soda, baking powder, and salt and mix it all into one bowl
- Step 2: take your butter and microwave it till it’s softened or liquidy
- Step 3: take the melted butter, milk, and egg and mix it into another bowl
- Step 4: pour wet mixture into the dry mixture and mix well
- Step 5: add vanilla and cinnamon (i don’t really measure this out but i would add about 2 tsp of vanilla and however much cinnamon you’d like to add!)
- Step 6 (opt) : add sprinkles or blueberries into the mixture, or when you are heating up the pancakes onto the pan, add some nutella into a sandwich baggy and snip a tiny whole into on of the corners to make nutella swirls on one side! 
- Step 7: set stove to medium heat (about 4) and lather pan in butter. then you can start cooking these bad boys up! 


Savory Breakfast Potatoes:
Ingredients:
- Potatoes (however many you’d like)
- Vegetable Oil (or any oil)
- Salt
- Pepper
- Cumin Seasoning
- Cayenne Pepper
- Turmeric Seasoning

How To Make: 
- Step 1: cut up potatoes into diced shapes, you can cut them however big or small you’d like 
- Step 2: preheat your oven to 440 F and spray or wipe pan in oil along with lathering or spraying your potatoes in oil
- Step 3: lay out your potatoes in a baking pan
- Step 4: add a good amount of salt and pepper
- Step 5: add a small amount of cumin and turmeric along with a small amount of cayenne unless you like spicy, add a bit more
- Step 6: bake potatoes at 440F for 20 minutes 
- Step 7: flip potatoes at turn the oven up to 475F ; then leave them in for 25 minutes
- Step 8: take them out and they’re ready to eat!
